name: Fukushuu no Odaku
source:
The water stagnates in anger and the wind carries revenge in London at the end of the 19th century. A detective, brings an occult case to Eric Curtis, a young man who has signed a contract with the devil for revenge.

A mysterious relic held by a drowning body floating on the Thames. Following the drifting mud and the scent of the occult, Eric meets another avenger.

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6299]NovelGame[/url]]
